item.title: What's the difference between a "disc" and a "disk"?
item.description:
📝 They're pronounced the same, but, technically speaking, there is a distinct difference between a disc and a disk. Discs A disc refers to optical media, such as an audio CD, CD-ROM, DVD-ROM, DVD-RAM or DVD-Video disc. Disks A disk refers to magnetic media, such as a floppy disk, the disk in your computer's hard drive, an external hard drive.
🔗 Read more: https://support.apple.com/en-gb/100749
